description: This file is a C header file that declares the exported API functions for a content filtering basic message component object. It includes license and copyright information, module description, and function prototypes related to creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the component.

methods.name: CfBasicMsgComponentCreate
methods.description: Creates a basic message component object, taking container, owner, and reserved handles as parameters.

methods.name: CfBasicMsgCOCreate
methods.description: Creates a content filtering basic message object, taking container, owner, and reserved handles as parameters.

methods.name: CfBasicMsgCORemove
methods.description: Removes the specified basic message object.

methods.name: CfBasicMsgCOEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the basic message component object.

methods.name: CfBasicMsgCOInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the basic message component object.
